message.content:
Yes—Atlanta residents can file noise complaints through the City’s official channels.  
Here’s how:

| Step | What to do | Contact |
|------|------------|---------|
| 1 | **Call 311** – Atlanta’s non-emergency hotline. The dispatcher will route your call to the appropriate department (usually Police or Code Enforcement). | 311 (or 404‑555‑1234) |
| 2 | **Use the online portal** – Many cities now allow you to submit a noise complaint via a web form. For Atlanta, you can visit the City of Atlanta’s official website and look for “Noise Complaint” under the “Public Safety” or “Code Enforcement” sections. | https://www.atlantaga.gov/ |
| 3 | **Visit the local police station** – If you prefer in person, you can go to the nearest police precinct and file a written complaint. | Check the Atlanta Police Department website for precinct addresses. |

**What information you’ll need:**  
- Your name and contact details (optional but helpful).  
- Date, time, and location of the disturbance.  
- Description of the noise (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs).  
- Any evidence you have (photos, videos, audio recordings).

Once filed, the police or code enforcement team will investigate and may issue citations or warnings if the noise violates city ordinances.
